$description: Standalone interactive button. Three style families, three sizes, and an icon-only mode combine into 18 variants. Anatomy: LeftIcon · Label · RightIcon, centered horizontal flex. Label is hidden when IconOnly=true; in that mode the LeftIcon slot carries the single visible glyph.

$anatomy.role: leading-icon slot; visibility driven by 'Show left icon' on IconOnly=false variants and hardcoded true on IconOnly=true variants
label; visibility hardcoded false on IconOnly=true variants
trailing-icon slot; visibility driven by 'Show right icon' on IconOnly=false variants and hardcoded false on IconOnly=true variants

$notes.states-not-built-as-variants: Hover and disabled bindings above are recorded for downstream consumers — they are NOT implemented as Figma variants. Only the default state of each (Style × Size × IconOnly) combination is rendered.
$notes.active-state-no-token: No semantic token covers the active/pressed state. Stopgap: CSS filter: brightness(0.95). System-level gap.
$notes.icon-color-binding-gap: Audit returned colorVar:null for every LeftIcon and RightIcon across all 18 variants — no variable binding was detected on the inner icon vector fills at the variant level. The component-set description claims icon colors of icon/primary/default (primary, secondary) and icon/brand/default (tertiary), but the audit could not confirm those bindings on the variant nodes. The 'icon' field under each style.<state> block is therefore intent-only here, not a recorded binding. Possible causes: (a) bindings live on overrides not surfaced by findAll on instances, (b) bindings were lost across the clone passes that produced the variants. Re-binding pass recommended.
$notes.disabled-bg-gap-secondary-tertiary: Only background/brand/disabled exists as a semantic disabled-bg token. Secondary and tertiary disabled blocks intentionally omit a 'background' alias — bg stays at default state; the disabled affordance is carried entirely by text and icon color.
$notes.tertiary-hover-undefined: The component-set description proposes background/brand/default as a tertiary hover treatment but no token authoritatively covers tertiary hover. The hover block under style.tertiary is left empty.
$notes.focus-state-empty: No focus-visible state implemented. focus block is empty by design.
$notes.border: Every variant has strokes:[]. The 'border' field is null in every style.<state> block — Button does not use a stroke binding.
$notes.icon-only-visibility-detach: On IconOnly=true variants, LeftIcon and RightIcon nodes have their 'visible' componentPropertyReferences detached (only 'mainComponent' ref kept) and visible is hardcoded — true for LeftIcon, false for RightIcon. This is required because Figma boolean visibility properties bound to a node's 'visible' field are shared globally across all variants of a set; without the detach, toggling 'Show left icon' would reach into IconOnly=true variants and misalign the icon-only intent.
